acquisition_method.evidence: Data-dependent acquisition was performed with the resolution of the Orbitrap set to 35,000, with a fill time of 120 ms and a limitation of 2 × 105 ions.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Captured proteins were reduced in 10 mM DTT in 50 mM HEPES pH 8.5 at 56 °C for 30 min and alkylated with 20 mM 2-chloroacetamide in 50 mM HEPES pH 8.5 for 30 min at room temperature in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested by trypsin (Promega) at 37 °C overnight using an enzyme-to-protein ratio of 1:50.

collision_energy.evidence: A normalized collision energy of 32 was applied.

fractionation_method.evidence: Offline high pH reverse phase fractionation was carried out on an Agilent 1200 Infinity high-performance liquid chromatography system, equipped with a Gemini C18 column (3 μm, 110 Å, 100 × 1.0 mm2, Phenomenex).

fragmentation_method.evidence: A normalized collision energy of 32 was applied.

instrument.evidence: The outlet of the analytical column was coupled directly to a QExactive plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) using the proxeon nanoflow source in positive ion mode.

ionization_type.evidence: The peptides were introduced into the QExactive plus via a Pico-Tip Emitter 360 µm OD × 20 µm ID; 10 µm tip (New Objective) applying a spray voltage of 2.3 kV.

labeling.evidence: Peptides were labeled with TMT10plex Isobaric Label Reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

mass_analyzer.evidence: Data-dependent acquisition was performed with the resolution of the Orbitrap set to 35,000, with a fill time of 120 ms and a limitation of 2 × 105 ions.
